convention_rule: Four similar objects in a left-to-right row; the single distinctly lit/green one marks the target, its position (1-4) giving the candidate ID Pn.
basis: R1 and R2 images each highlight the 3rd of 4 objects (green signal, lit dome) and both revealed P3. R3_A: of four trees, the 3rd is the only green, lit one. R3_B: of four fires, the 3rd burns green. Points to P3, which is not the client-correct P4.
